_comment: RoadAware v2 external-source collection and date-evidence config (notebook 09). Relative paths resolve against the backend root. Env overrides: ROADAWARE_BACKEND_ROOT, ROADAWARE_V2_EXTERNAL_ROOT (raw/cache root), ROADAWARE_V2_OUTPUT_ROOT (root for reports/v2/sources), ROADAWARE_V1_DATA_ROOT (read-only v1 data root), ROADAWARE_V2_PREFLIGHT_DIR (Codex preflight evidence, read-only), ROADAWARE_V2_OFFLINE=1 (cache only), ROADAWARE_V2_REFRESH=1 (re-download; changed bytes become a new version, never an overwrite). Status: research in progress; nothing here is an operational forecast source.

A cached search snippet claiming MM/DD is NOT a verified document. Any dictionary resource listed in the live package is snapshotted only; its content is not used as date-format proof. Typed XLSX date cells matched by original ACC_CODE are the primary evidence.

date_evidence.date_header: วันที่เกิดเหตุ
date_evidence.policy: Exact original ACC_CODE join only (no fuzzy matching, no row-order matching). A v1 CSV row is resolved only when every XLSX row with that ID has the same TYPED date cell, every v1 CSV row with that ID has the same raw date string, that XLSX date is one of the CSV row's own candidate readings, and the supporting context (province, time) of every XLSX row of the ID equals the CSV row. This is a publisher-counterpart-derived resolution, not independent ground truth. Both global readings (M/D and D/M) are reported per year only to show agreement; 2022 is mixed-format, so no global parser is applied. XLSX-only IDs and revisions are never added as events and never replace the v1 raw snapshot.

traffic.row_policy: Every parsed CSV row gets one row_class: blank_nonrecord (all cells blank: a filler line, counted, excluded from station data and statistics; raw bytes kept), incomplete_identity (content but blank route/control_section/survey_point/province: uncertain, never merged or guessed, excluded from statistics), duplicate_key (non-blank complete key shared by another row: flagged, excluded from statistics), station. rows_parsed = sum of the four. Totals valid only when finite and >= 0; heavy share valid only when finite and within 0..100; invalid values are counted and never used.

columns.source_sha256: sha256 of the source CSV bytes

station_schema.next_stage_use: province_key x survey year mean/median of valid totals of station rows from PRIOR available vintages only; never sums

traffic.unit_note: Annual average daily traffic (vehicles/day) at DOH survey points on DOH highways. Survey-point AADT cannot be summed into unique vehicles or real-time flow; later stages may use only mean/median/survey-coverage summaries per province.
traffic.availability_policy: Per-resource proxy available_from = max(catalog created, catalog last_modified) + 1 day (CKAN timestamps read as UTC). created alone is not conservative when bytes were revised. A survey vintage may feed a target date only if survey_year < target year AND available_from <= issue time. The catalog-vintage proxy does not prove the current bytes were publicly delivered then. Never use the target year's own annual AADT.

province_aliases.policy: Exact audited full-string aliases only, mapping a source spelling to the v1 77-province panel name for joins (traffic province_key and geography province_key / in_v1_panel). Raw text is preserved (traffic province_raw, points name_th). No fuzzy, substring, prefix or postal-code rules; any other value outside the panel stays explicit as not_in_v1_panel.
province_aliases.audit: Codex inspection 2026-11-10: in the DOH AADT CSVs for BE 2563-2568 (CE 2020-2025) every non-blank province value absent from the v1 panel was พระนครศรีอยุธยา (43/45/45/44/44/44 survey rows per year); the v1 panel spells the same province อยุธยา.

pinned_sources._comment: Exact sha256 pins of the Codex-verified preflight copies (preflight_dir/file). Local first: a matching registered preflight copy (or a pin-verified notebook cache) is used with no network call; HTTPS download only when neither exists or with ROADAWARE_V2_REFRESH=1. Bytes that differ from a pin are kept as registry versions and never used or relabelled; required sources stop the run for review.

geoboundaries_api.note: API metadata (license, source, build date); optional

geography.point_meaning: shapely representative_point inside each province polygon: a label/proxy weather query point, not a road or event location

weather.negative_value_policy_note: A negative finite precipitation value (observed: -0.1 mm in archived JMA GSM previous_day2 hours) is a per-hour value-quality error: that hour's rain becomes NaN in memory (never abs/clip/0), raw JSON bytes are kept, temperature and other hours are kept, any rain window containing it is NaN. Structural checks (exact variables, units, time grid, period, location count, timezone, grid coordinates, finite numbers) stay strict and still reject the chunk.
weather.quota_note: Free non-commercial Open-Meteo API, no key; official limits 600 calls/min, 5000/hour, 10000/day, requests longer than 14 days count fractionally (https://open-meteo.com/en/pricing). 77 points x 1826 days / 14 is about 10,000 weighted calls, so one run cannot finish: each run stops after max_weighted_calls_per_run (estimated weight) with stop reason quota_budget_per_run_reached_resume_later; rerun after an hour (and on another day if the daily limit is hit). Cached chunks are reused without waiting when their URL and sha256 match the registry. On HTTP 429 without a short Retry-After the run stops with partial coverage. Partial coverage is quota-limited, not a missing archive.
weather.aggregation_note: Open-Meteo hourly definitions (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs): temperature_2m is the instant value at valid time; precipitation is the sum over the PRECEDING hour. Temperature is bucketed by valid time; precipitation by its interval start (valid time - 1 h): the 00-06 block sums values valid 01:00..06:00 and a day sums 01:00..next-day 00:00. A day whose next-midnight value is not collected stays rain_missing (never a partial sum or 0). The availability guard uses the original valid times / nominal issue bounds of every row used, including rain's interval end.
weather.lead_note: previous_day2 = value from the run roughly 48 h before valid time (Open-Meteo docs). The nominal issue bound is valid_time - 48 h; this API lead does not prove the historical public delivery latency, so a 6 h publication buffer is assumed and features must satisfy bound + buffer <= target day - 1 at 18:00 local.

calendar.scope_note: Bank of Thailand national financial-institution (bank) holidays only. NOT the national public-holiday calendar; regional extras are not applied nationally; public holidays when banks open are not bank holidays.
calendar.known_from_convention: known_from is a date-only conservative circular/announcement date; a record is usable only from the END of that local day (known_from + 1 day 00:00 Asia/Bangkok). Original publication latency is not proven; historical bytes retrieved in 2026 are a research proxy.

calendar.policy: Reviewed BOT bank-holiday transcriptions (Codex visual review) are applied only when the reviewed copy's bytes match the live/cached download (PDF/PNG) or the HTML snapshot text contains every entry date. Records are versioned add/remove actions with known_from; as-of views replay them, never a forever-union. Bank holiday != public holiday. Unknown calendar coverage is not an ordinary day. Recurring Songkran (13-15 Apr) and New Year (31 Dec / 1 Jan) are deterministic calendar rules usable without bank-holiday membership.

readiness.available_at_policy: fixed recurring dates known in advance; bank-holiday records only when known_from + 1 day 00:00 local <= issue time; removals applied in as-of order
readiness.leakage_risk: low for fixed festivals; medium for bank holidays (publication latency proxy); high if special days announced after issue are used
